evidence.source_quote: properly handling and storing ESD-sensitive components
evidence.output_quote: 1. Carry only closed shielding bags or lidded conductive totes. 2. Closed bags/totes may ride on ordinary carts; open or partly filled containers need an ESD cart. Avoid sliding bags. 3. Hand over at the line/shipping dock; the receiver signs the issue record. 4. Outside the EPA, packages stay closed.

evidence.source_quote: operating procedures into personnel training requirements and daily processes in the warehouse
evidence.output_quote: Test wrist straps and footwear at the start of each shift (7.1). If a test fails, do not handle ESDS until replaced.

honored.consequence: Section 7.1 Check Schedule specifies testing wrist straps 'Once a year, during the annual audit', contradicting Section 4.1 & 9 ('every shift') and violating regular daily/before-use verification standards, creating severe risk of undetected grounding failures.
